treaty_name: Convention between the Kingdom of Denmark and the Czech Republic for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2011)
eif_quote: Overenskomsten trådte i medfør af artikel 27 i kraft den 17. december 2012.

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
c) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

2. However, the royalties mentioned in sub-paragraph a) of paragraph 3 may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement.

notes: Art. 27(1)(a): WHT provisions effective for income paid or credited on/after 1 January following entry into force -> 2013-01-01. Dividend 0% tier written as 'shall not exceed 0 per cent' (cap 0, modelled as exclusive). Art. 10(2)(b): 0% for recognised pension funds - not modelled. Royalties: 10% cap applies only to art. 12(3)(a) royalties (patents, trade marks, designs, plans, secret formulas, computer software, industrial/commercial/scientific equipment, know-how); copyright royalties (art. 12(3)(b)) are taxable only in the residence State (art. 12(1)-(2) give source taxing right only for 12(3)(a)). Protocol point 2: MFN - if CZ agrees a lower royalty rate/exemption with another EU member State, it applies automatically; not checked whether triggered. MLI: covered by both; MLI WHT effective date 2021-01-01 (treaty map). MLI art. 8 does not apply (CZ reserved under art. 8(3)(a)). No art. 35(7) reservation.
